name: Differentiable Gaussian Selection via Gumbel-Softmax and STE
definition: A differentiable mechanism to select a subset of Gaussians during training by converting continuous logits into a binary mask, enabling gradient-based optimization of Gaussian attributes despite discrete selection.
summary: Differentiable Gaussian Selection uses Gumbel-Softmax and the Straight-Through Estimator to enable gradient-based optimization of discrete Gaussian selection, unlike non-differentiable thresholding methods.
